Earlier we considered allowing renewal through age 30.
That proposal is superseded; it must not be implemented.
We accepted a shorter expiry: renewal is allowed only when 0 <= age < 17 and the token has not already been used.
Using an inclusive upper bound failed: a token aged exactly 17 was incorrectly renewed. Do not repeat that approach.
The current session.py module exists, but fixing its boundary checks and retaining the keyword-only API is still pending.
The launch announcement has already been drafted and is unrelated.
